title: ZCC enrolled devices
aliases: when did the device last check in

prose.text: "Is this endpoint enrolled, and what is it doing?" takes four questions in order. Removing a device is a separate path with its own timing.

steps.label: Is the device in the list at all?
steps.text: The list is paged and each SDK reads it differently: [[zcc.devices.listing]].

steps.label: What state is it in?
steps.text: States, the 16-device limit and the keepalive that moves a device between states: [[zcc.devices.lifecycle]].

steps.label: What do its fields say?
steps.text: Owner, hostname, times and service health, and where the list and details calls disagree: [[zcc.devices.record-fields]].

steps.label: Was it removed automatically?
steps.text: The device threshold, inactive removal and permanent deletion: [[zcc.devices.cleanup]].

prose.text: Removing devices and machine tunnels through the API: [[zcc.devices.removal-api]]. CSV exports, including why users disabled a service: [[zcc.devices.exports]]. One-time passwords for a device: [[zcc.passwords-and-otp.otp]]. Admin log fetch from a device: [[zcc.logging.collection]].
